topbar.signOutContent: You will be signed out of GoMingle Admin.

errors.fetchError: Failed to load data. Please try again.
errors.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

apiErrors.ERR_USER_CREATION_FAILED: This email address is already registered with the identity provider, so the account cannot be created. Retrying will not help — ask an administrator to release the address, or use a different one.
apiErrors.ERR_EMAIL_IN_USE: An account with this email already exists.
apiErrors.ERR_SELF_MODIFICATION: Use Edit Profile to manage your own account.
apiErrors.ERR_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: This is the last active Super Admin. At least one active Super Admin must exist before this account can be suspended, deleted, or have its role changed.
apiErrors.ERR_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: This module is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
apiErrors.ERR_ROLE_NOT_FOUND: The selected role no longer exists. Reload the page and choose a live role.

session.suspended: Your account has been suspended. Please contact support.
session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
session.invalid: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.

unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.subtitle: You are not authorized to view this page. Contact an administrator if you believe this is a mistake.
unauthorized.permissionsUnavailableTitle: Your permissions could not be loaded
unauthorized.permissionsUnavailableSubtitle: The server could not return your profile and permissions, so no modules can be shown. This is a server error, not a permissions problem — retry in a moment, and contact support if it persists.

validation.passwordMin8: Password must be at least 8 characters

screenSize.description: This section requires a desktop screen (1024px or wider) to use.
